model_annotations.Bulgarian: Диаграмата е кръгова диаграма, която показва разпределението на категориите в RolePlayPref. Има общо 13 категории, представени в диаграмата. Категориите са: "Movie Characters" (зелен), "Virtual Characters" (лилав), "Teleplay Characters" (син), "Custom Characters" (оранжев), "Real Characters" (жълт), "Scientists" (червен), "Artists" (кафяв), "Athletes" (зелено-кафяв), "Writers" (тъмносин), "Novel Characters" (светлосин), "Actors" (розов), "Influencers" (лимонено жълт) и "Game Characters" (сив). Процентите на секторите не са изрично посочени, но секторите са подредени визуално по низходящ размер. Диаграмата не включва легенда или етикети с проценти вътре в секторите, нито някой от секторите е визуално подчертан.
model_annotations.English: Figure 3 presents a pie chart illustrating the distribution of primary categories among 13 role-playing characters. The chart is divided into thirteen slices, visually ordered in descending size. These categories include Movie Characters (green, approximately 23%), Virtual Characters (purple, approximately 15%), Teleplay Characters (teal, approximately 13%), Novel Characters (orange, approximately 12%), Real Characters (red, approximately 12%), Scientists (blue, approximately 9%), Artists (light blue, approximately 8%), Writers (yellow, approximately 7%), Musicians (pink, approximately 6%), Actors (light green, approximately 5%), Influencers (gray, approximately 4%), Game Characters (brown, approximately 3%), and Athletes (dark blue, approximately 2%). A legend is located to the left of the chart, clearly identifying each category with its corresponding color. Percentage labels are not included directly within the slices but are provided in the accompanying caption.
model_annotations.German: Abbildung 3 veranschaulicht die Verteilung von drei primären Kategorien innerhalb von Subkategorien, wie sie in RolePlayPref vorkommen. Das Kreisdiagramm enthält insgesamt 13 Segmente, wobei jedes Segment eine andere Subkategorie innerhalb der größereren Kategorien darstellt. Die Segmente sind in absteigender Reihenfolge nach Größe angeordnet. Die Subkategorien sind Movie Characters (hellblau, etwa 2 %), Virtual Characters (hellgrün, etwa 2 %), Teleplay Characters (gelb, etwa 2 %), Novel Characters (orange, etwa 2 %), Real Characters (rosa, etwa 2 %), Scientists (lila, etwa 2 %), Artists (helllila, etwa 2 %), Athletes (hellorange, etwa 2 %), Musicians (hellrosa, etwa 2 %), Writers (dunkelgelb, etwa 3 %), Actors (hellbraun, etwa 3 %), Influencers (hellviolett, etwa 3 %) und Game Characters (dunkelgrün, etwa 3 %). Das Diagramm verfügt über eine Legende, die jede Subkategorie und ihre entsprechende Farbe angibt.
